bio:
I'm Srijayee — a fashion and luxury content strategist working at the intersection of brand storytelling, SEO-driven copywriting, and personal styling. My work has shaped digital narrative for heritage brands including Manyavar, Taneira, and Tanishq.

I hold a Fashion & Luxury Brand Management credential from Bocconi University, and I bring that same brand-level thinking to every project — whether it's a product description, a partnership pitch, or someone's personal wardrobe.

Before this, I worked in content at Amazon — an unconventional path into fashion that I write about openly, because I think how you get somewhere matters as much as where you land.
